name: MonarchTheme
title: ToggleButton
wrapsNative: MonarchIconButton (the checked overload: Modifier.toggleable with the checkbox role) and MonarchChip for a toggle with a text label
summary: A button that stays on or off, such as Bold in a text toolbar or "Show archived" above a list: the checked MonarchIconButton and a selectable MonarchChip.
whenToUse: For an option that is switched in place and shown as a button: the checked MonarchIconButton for an icon, MonarchChip for a short text label.
whenNotToUse: For a setting in a list or a form use MonarchSwitchRow. For one choice out of several use MonarchRadioRow or segmented buttons. For an action that does not stay on use MonarchButton.
api: @Composable fun MonarchIconButton(label: String, checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, shape: Shape? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, icon: @Composable () -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchChip(text: String, selected: Boolean, onSelectedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchTagSize = MonarchTagSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, selectedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: checked / selected
options.description: Whether the option is on. State is hoisted: the app keeps it.

options.name: onCheckedChange / onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the new value when the user switches the option.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can switch the option.

options.name: label + icon / text
options.description: The icon toggle takes a label, its TalkBack name, and a MonarchIcon with a null content description; MonarchChip takes its text. The name must not change with the state.

states.name: off
states.description: Icon toggle: no fill and the muted icon color. Chip: a hairline border and no fill.

states.name: on
states.description: Icon toggle: the accent subtle fill with the accent strong icon. Chip: the accent tint with accent text and an accent border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled text color (an on icon toggle keeps a muted fill); taps are ignored.

appearance: An off icon toggle has no fill and the muted icon color, one surface step on hover and press; an on one has the accent subtle fill and the accent strong icon, like the web's pressed tools. A selected chip has the accent tint, accent text and an accent border. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ToggleButton is a button with aria-pressed and the variants default (borderless until pressed) and outline; iOS ships MonarchToggleButtonStyle for the standard Toggle. On Android an icon toggle is the checked overload of MonarchIconButton (ghost until pressed, then the accent tint with the strong accent icon, like the web default; TalkBack reads the label and whether it is checked), and a toggle with a text label is a selectable MonarchChip. The web outline variant is not offered. The web uncontrolled form (defaultPressed) does not exist: state is hoisted. The icon toggle has the icon button sizes (32, 36 or 40dp) and the chip is 28dp, each inside a 48dp target.
accessibility: The icon toggle has the Checkbox role and is read as checked or not checked with its label; TalkBack says "double-tap to toggle".
MonarchChip exposes a selected state, read as selected or not selected.
Every form reserves a touch target of at least 48dp by 48dp.
A disabled toggle is read as disabled and ignores taps.
On is a change of fill and content color together; the label names the option and does not change with the state.
The chip label scales with the font size setting and is not cut off at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: An icon toggle has no visible text, so its label is required and is the TalkBack name.
A long chip label grows the chip instead of being cut off; keep it to a few words.
There is one icon toggle look; the web outline variant is not offered.

parityExceptions.reason: NATIVE GAP: the web text toggle button has the default (borderless until pressed) and outline variants, and a leading icon; the Android text toggle is a selectable MonarchChip, which offers no outline variant
